sentences.en: The city incinerated the old tires to reduce waste.
sentences.zh: 城市把旧轮胎焚烧以减少废物。

sentences.en: They decided to incinerate the documents to protect their secrets.
sentences.zh: 他们决定焚烧文件以防泄露机密。

sentences.en: The medical waste was incinerated daily at the hospital.
sentences.zh: 医院每天会把医疗废物焚烧处理。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：in（使…）+ciner（灰）+ate →使成灰→焚化
